reason: The Jumia Vendor API (OpenAPI https://vendorcenter.jumia.com/api-docs/openapi.yaml, opened 2026-09-25; the docs_url is a seller KYC help page) is the SELLER side of Jumia: a vendor manages its own product feeds, stock/price and fulfils the orders it receives (pack, ready-to-ship, labels) with OAuth bearer tokens. There is no API for buying from Jumia, so this category's list_products (supplier catalogue), quote_shipping and create_order (spends money at a supplier) have no counterpart; the seller side belongs in ecommerce_channels/jumia.
